"### Chart Description: Policy Rate and Inflation

This chart tracks three economic indicators over time, measured in monthly percentage changes (Percent, m/m).

**Chart Components:**
*   **Title:** Policy Rate and Inflation
*   **Unit:** (Percent, m/m)
*   **Y-Axis:** 0 to 30 (increments of 5)
*   **X-Axis:** Time periods from 1-Aug to 27-May
*   **Legend:**
    *   **LELIQ:** Solid dark blue line (ends mid-December)
    *   **Pases ON:** Dashed medium blue line
    *   **Inflation:** Solid light blue line

---

### Extracted Data Values (Approximate)

The data follows a "step" pattern, remaining constant between the dates listed on the X-axis.

| Date Period (Approx.) | Inflation (%) | LELIQ (%) | Pases ON (%) |
| :--- | :---: | :---: | :---: |
| 1-Aug | ~7.5 | ~6.0 | ~8.0 |
| 11-Aug to 30-Sep | ~12.5 | ~10.0 | ~9.8 |
| 30-Sep to 10-Oct | ~8.5 | ~10.0 | ~9.8 |
| 10-Oct to 30-Oct | ~8.5 | ~11.2 | ~11.0 |
| 30-Oct to 9-Dec | ~13.0 | ~11.2 | ~11.0 |
| 9-Dec to 19-Dec | ~25.5 | ~11.2 | ~11.0 |
| 19-Dec to 29-Dec | ~25.5 | (Not plotted) | ~8.8 |
| 29-Dec to 28-Jan | ~20.5 | (Not plotted) | ~8.8 |
| 28-Jan to 27-Feb | ~13.5 | (Not plotted) | ~8.8 |
| 27-Feb to 8-Mar | ~11.0 | (Not plotted) | ~8.8 |
| 8-Mar to 28-Mar | ~11.0 | (Not plotted) | ~7.0 |
| 28-Mar to 7-Apr | ~9.0 | (Not plotted) | ~7.0 |
| 7-Apr to 17-Apr | ~9.0 | (Not plotted) | ~6.0 |
| 17-Apr to 27-Apr | ~9.0 | (Not plotted) | ~5.2 |
| 27-Apr to 17-May | (Not plotted) | (Not plotted) | ~4.2 |
| 17-May to 27-May | (Not plotted) | (Not plotted) | ~3.5 |

---

### Summary of Trends
*   **Inflation:** Remained relatively stable near 12.5% until a significant spike to over 25% in December. It has since steadily declined, ending the period near 9%.
*   **LELIQ:** This policy rate increased in steps from 6% to roughly 11.2% before the data series ended in mid-December.
*   **Pases ON:** Closely followed the LELIQ rate until December. Since late December, it has undergone a series of sharp decreases, falling from nearly 9% to approximately 3.5% by late May."
